# List of presidents and vice-presidents of the Assembly of States Parties of the International Criminal Court__disambig_1

The Assembly of States Parties of the International Criminal Court (ICC) elects a president and two vice-presidents of the assembly to serve three-year terms.
In December 2004, the Assembly's Bureau established two working groups based in the two main locations relevant to its work, The Hague and New York. At first, these working groups had separate coordinators, but since the presidency of the 7th to 9th sessions, they have each been coordinated by one of the vice-presidents.
The following table lists the presidents and vice-presidents of the Assembly of States Parties since the ICC's inception in 2002. The vice-presidents of the first two presidencies are listed according to the location of their diplomatic positions at the time.
